digest.component_or_area: pytest-timeout configuration and CI workflow integration
propositions: The per-test hang budget was reduced from 300s to 20s in commit 6a5c88027c5, placing it below the measured 18.7-29.93s execution cost band of ~14 legitimate whole-tree-scan tests on coverage-enabled CI legs, causing worker crashes.

With timeout_method=thread, pytest-timeout calls os._exit(1) to kill the xdist worker process rather than reporting a Failed: Timeout verdict, making budget expiries invisible in test output while manifesting as node-down crashes.

The Verified gate executes workflow files from trusted main (not the patchset), so a config-only budget fix in pyproject.toml cannot pass its own gate if main's stale CLI --timeout flag takes precedence (CLI > INI precedence).

Dead workers under --dist loadgroup re-dispatch their pending items to respawned workers that crash on the same item up to numprocesses*4 restarts, amplifying the outage toward the 60-minute job timeout ceiling.

The fix restores timeout=300 in both pyproject.toml ini and the two shared-tier _build-and-test.yml lanes' explicit --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread flags, with headroom contract tests ensuring budget >= 2x the measured worst case and <= 600s.
